name: Adopt A Stream Project Funding
summary: Financial and technical support for Nova Scotia community groups restoring fish habitat, such as fish passage, riparian and in-stream work, covering up to half of eligible project costs from the Sportfish Habitat Fund.

eligibility.rule: Project work is not required by the Fisheries Act or a government order

status.quote: ANNUAL APPLICATION DEADLINE - 2025 extension January 20th To allow for review and timely notice of approval of project funding for the coming field season, the deadline is January 20th, 2025.

deadline.quote: ANNUAL APPLICATION DEADLINE - 2025 extension January 20th To allow for review and timely notice of approval of project funding for the coming field season, the deadline is January 20th, 2025.

applicant_types.quote: provides financial and technical support to non-profit, community groups in Nova Scotia undertaking projects that improve or restore fish habitat and fish populations

geography.quote: provides financial and technical support to non-profit, community groups in Nova Scotia undertaking projects that improve or restore fish habitat and fish populations

access.quote: Scroll down page for the application and budget forms.

window.quote: ANNUAL APPLICATION DEADLINE - 2025 extension January 20th To allow for review and timely notice of approval of project funding for the coming field season, the deadline is January 20th, 2025.

co_finance_required.quote: NSSA Adopt A Stream Project Funding will contribute up to 50% of eligible project costs.

administered_by.quote: The funding that the NSSA receives from the Nova Scotia Sportfish Habitat Fund is distributed to community groups for habitat restoration projects

effort.quote: Applications must be sent electronically in Word and Excel formats

eligibility.quote: Work required of a project proponent, owner, or occupier by the Fisheries Act or under any order or mitigation requirement issued by DFO, Environment Canada, NS Environment or any other government department.

co_finance.quote: Adopt A Stream will contribute financial support to match the value of the community organizations' volunteer time, donated services & materials, and other financial support. NSSA Adopt A Stream Project Funding will contribute up to 50% of eligible project costs.

documents.quote: Attach representative photos of proposed work sites / watercourses
Also attach the Detailed Project Budget (Microsoft Excel Spreadsheet template)
